Metadata.title: Rehla — Your companion on the road to the light
Metadata.description: An AI-powered platform that accompanies new Muslims from the moment they declare the Shahada to confident practice and belonging, in their own language and grounded in approved sources.

Guide.label: How Rehla works

road.title: Your road, step by step
road.body: Three stations: the beginning, then purification, then prayer. You choose where to start and continue whenever you like.

class.title: Every lesson is a small class
class.body: A board where the lesson is written line by line, with Rafiq beside you. The text comes from approved sources, and its source is written under it.

hands.title: You learn with your hands
hands.body: You put the steps of wudu in order, build a rak'ah, and move the sun to find each prayer's time. Then short questions fix what you learned, and a stamp in your journal for every lesson you finish.

question.title: Try a question
question.body: This is how the short questions come after a lesson. Answer it; a mistake does not count against you, and every lesson you finish is stamped in your journal.

situations.title: Practise everyday situations
situations.body: In Mawqif you practise moments you will meet, like greeting people or visiting someone who is ill: what to say, why and when, from the sources, then a short role-play.

together.title: You are not alone
together.body: Ask Rafiq whenever you need something explained, and when your question needs a specialist we point you to one.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.description: What Rehla keeps, where it is kept, and what it never asks or works out.
Privacy.guestTitle: As a guest, everything stays on this device
Privacy.guestBody: You can use all of Rehla without an account. Your progress, journal, provisions, conversations with Rafiq and settings are kept in this browser only, under an anonymous session.
Privacy.accountIntro: An account is optional. It keeps your progress and provisions and carries them to any device.
Privacy.keptTitle: What an account keeps, and why
Privacy.keptEmail: Your email and password, to sign you in. The password is held by the sign-in service in a protected form that no one can read.
Privacy.keptName: A display name you choose, to show in your account. It need not be your real name, and it is never sent to the AI service.
Privacy.keptCountry: Your country, only if you pick it from the list. It is never guessed from your address, your language or anything else.
Privacy.keptLocale: The site language you signed up in.
Privacy.keptProgress: Your progress, so it follows you: lessons completed, the station you chose to start from, checks, quizzes and station exams, the sentences kept in your journal, practice results and provisions, and whether you have seen the tour.
Privacy.neverTitle: What we never collect or infer
Privacy.neverBody: No field, record or log holds your religious background, when you became Muslim, your former faith, your family, your health or any other sensitive matter, and nothing about you is worked out from what you do. Your starting point on the road is the one you choose.
Privacy.whereAccount: Account data is kept in Rehla's database (Supabase), where each account can reach only its own records.
Privacy.whereDevice: Your conversations with Rafiq stay on this device only, with or without an account. So do the conversations beside lesson boards, the name you gave Rafiq, the city you chose and your personal checklists.
Privacy.rafiqBody: To answer, the AI service receives your question, the page language, the lessons you have completed and the last few turns of the conversation. It keeps none of it after replying, and it never receives your name or anything about your account. To answer and to find sources, your question is sent to an AI model provider (OpenRouter) and to the Association for Multilingual Islamic Content's server. Nothing is stored.
Privacy.controlAccount: On your account page, “Download my data” gives you a file of everything your account holds, and “Delete my account and data” removes it all for good. Signing out removes your account's data from this device.
Privacy.controlGuest: As a guest, erase your journal from the journal page, and clear what Rafiq remembers from the Rafiq page.
Privacy.nameBody: The name Rafiq calls you by stays on this device, or in your own profile if you have an account. It is never sent to the AI model provider: Rafiq leaves a place for it, and your device fills it in.
Privacy.lensBody: The photo is sent to an AI model provider to be read; nothing is kept. Lens never describes people, does not read out personal documents, and infers nothing about you from a photo.
Privacy.mawqifBody: A reply you write in a role-play is sent to the AI model provider to be checked against that turn's points, and is not kept. Nothing about you is inferred from it. Choosing one of the written replies sends nothing.
Privacy.communityBody: Joining the community is a separate choice after you sign in. Others see only the community name you choose (it need not be your real name), a badge if the team gave you one, and your country only if you switch it on. There are no profile pages, member lists or private messages, and nothing is inferred from what you write.
Privacy.communityChecks: Before a post or reply is shared, its text is sent to the AI service to look for distress or a request for a ruling; the service keeps and logs none of it. Personal details such as phone numbers are spotted on your device. You always decide whether to share.
Privacy.communityAsk: “Ask Rafiq about this” keeps the post on this device until you send a question; it never goes into a link. When you send it, the post's title and text go to the AI service with your question, like any question, and are not kept.
Privacy.communityLeave: You can leave at any time and choose to delete your posts and replies or keep them as from a “Former member”. Deleting your account removes them, and “Download my data” includes them.

Mawqif.howItWorks: Each situation: the words to say, quoted from their source, with Rafiq's plain explanation; then a conversation with someone you might really meet, and feedback on each reply.

Community.title: Rehla Community
Community.description: A calm place where new Muslims, and the people who support them, share experience, encourage each other and learn together.
Community.calmLine: Replies here are members' own experience, not rulings. For a question about your own situation, ask Rafiq privately or a specialist.

unavailable.title: The community is not available here
unavailable.body: This copy of Rehla runs without accounts, so the community is switched off. Everything else works as usual.

Community.error: The community could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

rules.title: How we talk here
rules.kind: Be kind and patient: everyone here is on their own road.
rules.experience: Share experience and encouragement, not rulings. Point religious questions to Rafiq or a specialist.
rules.source: If you pass on religious information, name its source.
rules.privacy: Keep privacy, yours and others': no phone numbers, addresses or anything that identifies anyone.
rules.noAds: No advertising and no commercial links.
rules.report: Report what breaks these rules. Anything reported by three members is hidden until the team reviews it.
rules.care: If you are going through something hard or are in danger, do not wait for replies: contact a specialist or emergency services.

categoryHints.askCommunity: Practical questions about members' experience. Not rulings.
